content.title: Reproduce: regenerate returns 401 in open auth mode (BUG-1)
content.description: Reproduce BUG-1: POST /api/users/:name/regenerate returns 401 in open auth mode. Confirm the root cause — the webapp server route (packages/webapp/server/routes/users.ts:54) calls tracker.usersRegenerate(name) without forwarding auth context, so resolveAuthor returns the default user ('anonymous') which fails the self-service check in usersRegenerate (callerName !== targetName). Note: e2e/packages/webapp/e2e/phase4-validation.spec.ts:197-216 currently asserts this 401 (locking the bug in as passing).
